data_manifest.instrument_label: COMEX gold futures front-month proxy; not spot XAUUSD

measure_definitions.hourly_60m: Primary: last hourly Close before the release to the first hourly Close at or after 60 minutes after the release.
measure_definitions.daily_close_to_close: Fallback: previous available trading-day Close to release-day Close.
measure_definitions.unavailable: No usable source observations; never converted to a zero or a guessed result.

records.phase_note: Leading indicators and model score are intentionally unavailable until Phase 3.

price_reaction.definition: Last Yahoo hourly Close timestamped before the release to the first Yahoo hourly Close timestamped at or after release + 60 minutes.
